titulo.estudio: Направление: в город и на работу
titulo.alumno:
«Направление: в город и на работу»
Direction with в and на

intro: To indicate where one is going, в or на usually takes the accusative: в музей, в город, на работу.

piezas.titulo: To indicate where one is going, в or на usually takes the accusative: в музей, в город, на работу.
texto: To indicate where one is going, в or на usually takes the accusative: в музей, в город, на работу.
Compare the pair: где? в музее; куда? в музей. The change of case helps distinguish location from destination.

frases.alumno: Tomorrow I am going to the library.
They are going to the station.

pregunta.texto: Which form answers куда? for музей?

opciones.explicacion: В музей indicates the destination; в музее indicates the place.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Завтра я иду в библиотеку.»

opciones.texto: Tomorrow I am going to the library.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: They are going to the station.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

piezas.traduccion: They are going to the station.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
